| description = Regis the Reverent spawns at loc (1450, -1560) immediately upon the death of [[Zahal the Vile]]. The spawn point is on the north zone wall hillside; just below the tree that is above and between the two large trees at the bottom. Although he is a zombie, Regis is a coward and flees at low health.

Zahal's spawn timer is 4 hours so Regis spawns about every 4 hours. (Zahal doesn't usually live long.) Regis will despawn after 60 minutes if not killed. If you are camping Regis, then it is advisable to pull Zahal to Regis' spawn point so you will be present for the spawn.

Note: On the green server, the Silver Griffon does not place hold for Zahal currently as of May 4th, 2020. He shouldn't placehold in the timeline.
